recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中央兩顆顆粒球前驅細胞（後骨髓細胞／帶狀核）核型已接近成熟，胞質卻呈淡灰藍色、幾乎沒有顆粒，這種顆粒減少（hypogranular）是典型的顆粒球發育不良；周圍另有數顆紅血球系前驅細胞。
features: Hypogranular granulocytic precursors: metamyelocyte with a kidney-shaped nucleus and pale gray, nearly agranular cytoplasm
Second hypogranular precursor with a deeply indented, band-like to bilobed nucleus
Several erythroid precursors (polychromatic and basophilic normoblasts) with round dense nuclei and blue cytoplasm
A granulated promyelocyte/myelocyte at upper left and a large immature cell at bottom edge
Blasts not clearly increased in this field; blast count requires a full differential
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with striking hypogranulation, including a metamyelocyte and a band-like form with pale gray, nearly agranular cytoplasm despite nuclear maturation. Scattered polychromatic and basophilic normoblasts and a normally granulated promyelocyte are also present, and a large immature cell is partly seen at the bottom edge. Dysgranulopoiesis is evident; with 5% blasts on the aspirate differential, the findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts (former RAEB-1).

ddx.vs: Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and folded lacy chromatin, while hypogranular metamyelocytes retain coarser clumped granulocytic chromatin.
Poor staining causes uniform loss of granule color in all cells, whereas here adjacent promyelocytes retain granules, confirming true hypogranulation.
Reactive precursors show normal or toxic granulation rather than agranular cytoplasm and lack clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

ddx.dx: MDS with low blasts / single lineage dysplasia
ddx.vs: Separation from MDS-EB depends on blast count (<5% marrow and <2% blood) rather than dysplasia morphology.
